worker_decode: free greedy, validate actual JSON afterwards, no output masking or content repair
planner_decode: greedy with JSON action grammar, all action decisions produced by the model
runtime_feedback: each new Planner context receives current files/check, exact current task ledger and actual proposals, last action/result and an optional Planner-authored note; full events remain on disk
shared_system: current explicit invocation selects Planner or Worker role at the same instruction level
scope: Four new configuration development parents; autonomous optional delegation; receiver interface comparison only
worker_transport_policy: accept a single complete JSON object with optional outer code fence; allow informational summary on check/inspect; preserve actual action and values, record original strict-contract status, reject truncation and unauthorized edits
stop_policy: one complete pass; no sampling, budget or prompt recovery; keep all failures; zero delegation is valid
